hypothesis: Initialize a stochastic partial-graph policy by behavior cloning reconstruction trajectories over a fixed corpus-derived vocabulary of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, then construct each proposal de novo with valence-masked attachment and stop actions and reuse every task-local oracle-scored trajectory uniformly in corrected twin soft-Q, entropy-regularized actor, and automatic-temperature updates, placing reward only on the terminal transition so feedback changes later fragment decisions.
method_thesis: Decompose the allowed unlabeled corpus into a fixed vocabulary of chemically sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and use its reconstruction trajectories only to behavior-clone a task-agnostic graph policy. In each independent objective session, start complete constructions from a sampled vocabulary fragment and repeatedly sample a three-part categorical action: an open attachment site on the current partial graph, a fragment, and a compatible attachment site on that fragment, with an explicit stop action and valence-checked transitions. Canonicalize completed graphs and submit only fresh valid unique assemblies in the evaluator-announced batch; the vocabulary is a combinatorial action alphabet, not a pool of whole-molecule candidates. Put the scored initial molecules when representable and every subsequently generated trajectory into a task-local replay buffer, assign the observed oracle score only at the terminal transition, and update corrected twin soft-Q critics, the stochastic actor, and its entropy temperature from uniformly replayed transitions. The next molecules are sampled directly from the updated actor, so no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or screened and no finite molecular candidate set is enumerated. Off-policy trajectory reuse lets each scarce terminal observation train many partial-graph decisions, while maximum-entropy action sampling resists early policy collapse; both serve the sole benchmark target of a stronger final Top-1 on each session.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus admits sanitized attachment-labelled decompositions with enough repeated reconstruction actions to behavior-clone a chemically productive partial-graph policy and fixed fragment vocabulary.

The fixed initial molecules are at least partly representable by the construction grammar, and useful objective-specific structures are reachable by sequences of compatible attachments drawn from the fixed vocabulary.
Returned oracle scores have enough variation for terminal rewards to distinguish construction trajectories and for twin soft-Q updates to create actionable differences within 29 feedback rounds.
Uniform reuse of all partial transitions supplies adequate credit propagation despite sparse terminal rewards, while entropy regularization preserves sufficient exploration under the 300-call budget.

Valence masking, fragment compatibility, sanitization, and local novelty filtering maintain sufficient terminal yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the proposal-attempt and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when decisive chemistry requires fragments absent from the fixed vocabulary, coordinated graph rearrangements outside sequential attachment, horizons too long for terminal credit to propagate, or objectives whose rewards are too flat or deceptive for stable task-local actor-critic learning.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if behavior cloning does not reduce held-out valid-action negative log likelihood, emitted molecules cannot be traced to valence-checked fragment actions from the fixed vocabulary, or accepted oracle-scored trajectories are not uniformly replayed through terminal-reward twin-soft-Q updates that reduce paired Bellman residual and induce an entropy-regularized actor or temperature change before later suggestions.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to fragment only the unlabeled corpus into a bounded fixed vocabulary with explicit attachment labels, derive valid reconstruction trajectories, behavior-clone a compact graph-conditioned factorized categorical actor, and publish the vocabulary, configuration, and actor weights. Implement run mode to seed all RNGs from init, load the prepared actor on logical cuda:0, create task-local twin critics, target critics, replay memory, and entropy temperature, and begin each construction from a sampled vocabulary fragment. At each partial graph, sample an explicit stop or a three-part action selecting an open attachment site, a vocabulary fragment, and a compatible fragment attachment site under chemical-validity masks; apply only valence-checked attachments, canonicalize completed graphs, and locally reject invalid, evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate terminals until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Reconstruct and admit scored initial molecules when representable, retain the full trajectory for every accepted generated molecule, assign its returned oracle score only to the terminal transition, sample all stored transitions uniformly, and after observe perform corrected twin soft-Bellman critic updates, a stochastic maximum-entropy actor update, target-network updates, and automatic entropy-temperature adjustment before sampling the next batch directly from the updated actor, without surrogate pre-ranking or whole-molecule corpus retrieval.
research_intent.mechanism: Initialize a stochastic partial-graph policy by behavior cloning reconstruction trajectories over a fixed corpus-derived vocabulary of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, then construct each proposal de novo with valence-masked attachment and stop actions and reuse every task-local oracle-scored trajectory uniformly in corrected twin soft-Q, entropy-regularized actor, and automatic-temperature updates, placing reward only on the terminal transition so feedback changes later fragment decisions.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a fragment-construction policy receives sparse terminal rewards for long sequences of partial-graph decisions and has only 29 feedback boundaries at this profile in which to propagate them; it must reuse each scored trajectory without collapsing exploration while still assembling enough valid, novel terminal molecules to fill every batch.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the unlabeled corpus yields enough repeated attachment-labelled subgraph actions for behavior cloning: this preparation produced 16,700 actions over a 64-fragment vocabulary, and held-out NLL decreased overall and in all five action components.

The claimed initial-molecule representability condition is not supported here: all five sessions represented 0/10 initial molecules, so evidence applies to learning from generated trajectories rather than warm-starting from the fixed panel.

Supported when the fixed vocabulary and compatibility map can sustain de novo construction: 1,450 proposals were emitted at aggregate completed-trajectory yield 0.9843856076035302 with no logged valence or sanitization failures and every announced batch filled.

Supported when returned rewards vary enough to train the task-local critics and actor: the adaptive trajectories had many distinct score values on every task, mean critic residual change was negative on every task, and every one of 707 completed actor gains was positive.

Uniform replay supplied measurable but incomplete credit propagation under this buffer/update ratio: 74.20619860847565% of adaptive nonterminal transitions were sampled at least once and 1,346 trajectories were reused after their creation batch.

Operational applicability to the frozen full-session protocol is not established until stop handling is repaired: all five sessions consumed the complete oracle budget but returned null formal scores because they did not exit within the post-stop grace period.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and does not establish transfer when useful chemistry requires fragments outside this vocabulary, complete reconstruction of initial molecules, longer credit horizons, or graph rearrangements outside sequential compatible attachment.

Supported when the fixed vocabulary and compatibility map can sustain de novo construction: 1,450 proposals were emitted at aggregate completed-trajectory yield 0.9843856076035302 with no logged valence or sanitization failures and every announced batch filled.

Supported when returned rewards vary enough to train the task-local critics and actor: the adaptive trajectories had many distinct score values on every task, mean critic residual change was negative on every task, and every one of 707 completed actor gains was positive.

Uniform replay supplied measurable but incomplete credit propagation under this buffer/update ratio: 74.20619860847565% of adaptive nonterminal transitions were sampled at least once and 1,346 trajectories were reused after their creation batch.

Operational applicability to the frozen full-session protocol is not established until stop handling is repaired: all five sessions consumed the complete oracle budget but returned null formal scores because they did not exit within the post-stop grace period.

Evidence is limited to screening seed 0 and does not establish transfer when useful chemistry requires fragments outside this vocabulary, complete reconstruction of initial molecules, longer credit horizons, or graph rearrangements outside sequential compatible attachment.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus admits sanitized attachment-labelled decompositions with enough repeated reconstruction actions to behavior-clone a chemically productive partial-graph policy and fixed fragment vocabulary.

The fixed initial molecules are at least partly representable by the construction grammar, and useful objective-specific structures are reachable by sequences of compatible attachments drawn from the fixed vocabulary.
Returned oracle scores have enough variation for terminal rewards to distinguish construction trajectories and for twin soft-Q updates to create actionable differences within 29 feedback rounds.
Uniform reuse of all partial transitions supplies adequate credit propagation despite sparse terminal rewards, while entropy regularization preserves sufficient exploration under the 300-call budget.

Valence masking, fragment compatibility, sanitization, and local novelty filtering maintain sufficient terminal yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the proposal-attempt and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when decisive chemistry requires fragments absent from the fixed vocabulary, coordinated graph rearrangements outside sequential attachment, horizons too long for terminal credit to propagate, or objectives whose rewards are too flat or deceptive for stable task-local actor-critic learning.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if behavior cloning does not reduce held-out valid-action negative log likelihood, emitted molecules cannot be traced to valence-checked fragment actions from the fixed vocabulary, or accepted oracle-scored trajectories are not uniformly replayed through terminal-reward twin-soft-Q updates that reduce paired Bellman residual and induce an entropy-regularized actor or temperature change before later suggestions.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to fragment only the unlabeled corpus into a bounded fixed vocabulary with explicit attachment labels, derive valid reconstruction trajectories, behavior-clone a compact graph-conditioned factorized categorical actor, and publish the vocabulary, configuration, and actor weights. Implement run mode to seed all RNGs from init, load the prepared actor on logical cuda:0, create task-local twin critics, target critics, replay memory, and entropy temperature, and begin each construction from a sampled vocabulary fragment. At each partial graph, sample an explicit stop or a three-part action selecting an open attachment site, a vocabulary fragment, and a compatible fragment attachment site under chemical-validity masks; apply only valence-checked attachments, canonicalize completed graphs, and locally reject invalid, evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate terminals until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Reconstruct and admit scored initial molecules when representable, retain the full trajectory for every accepted generated molecule, assign its returned oracle score only to the terminal transition, sample all stored transitions uniformly, and after observe perform corrected twin soft-Bellman critic updates, a stochastic maximum-entropy actor update, target-network updates, and automatic entropy-temperature adjustment before sampling the next batch directly from the updated actor, without surrogate pre-ranking or whole-molecule corpus retrieval.
research_intent.mechanism: Initialize a stochastic partial-graph policy by behavior cloning reconstruction trajectories over a fixed corpus-derived vocabulary of sanitized attachment-labelled fragments, then construct each proposal de novo with valence-masked attachment and stop actions and reuse every task-local oracle-scored trajectory uniformly in corrected twin soft-Q, entropy-regularized actor, and automatic-temperature updates, placing reward only on the terminal transition so feedback changes later fragment decisions.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a fragment-construction policy receives sparse terminal rewards for long sequences of partial-graph decisions and has only 29 feedback boundaries at this profile in which to propagate them; it must reuse each scored trajectory without collapsing exploration while still assembling enough valid, novel terminal molecules to fill every batch.
